title: Characterize a reusable lesson from an engineering finding
description: Distinguish the observed basis, inferred mechanism, reuse rationale, and applicability limits of a proposed engineering lesson. This behavior decides how the finding is characterized without asserting that an improvement has been adopted or effective.
inputs: Identifiable failure or review finding and its attributable observations.
Proposed causal explanation, original activity context, and candidate reusable implications.
preconditions: The finding can be identified, with missing evidence explicitly reportable.
outputs: A characterized lesson candidate with observations, inferences, support, and applicability limits distinguished.
A local-correction disposition or an unresolved-support finding when reuse is not justified.
behavior: Keep observed facts and their sources separate from causal interpretation.
Assess reuse against recurring failures, reusable weaknesses, or a high-consequence event with broader applicability.
Record the proposed mechanism, supporting basis, relevant situations, and exclusions.
Keep unsupported causes provisional and contradictions visible.
Return findings without reusable implications to their owning Change as local corrections without manufacturing lessons.

failure_behavior.condition: Observation sources are missing or undermine the proposed cause.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the support gap and preserve the hypothesis as unconfirmed.
Report a local-correction disposition instead of claiming a general rule.

sources.basis: SR-035 requires supported lesson selection, separation of observations and inferences, and explicit applicability.

Propose MOD-009 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
